mentions.name: Popotopo
mentions.description: Popotopo is a web app for learning world geography, covering areas such as US states and countries in Africa, built as a modern alternative to dated existing geography learning tools.
mentions.problem: Existing options for learning geography look like they are from 1999.
mentions.audience: Wanted to improve personal knowledge of world geography, such as US states and countries in Africa.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to be better acquainted with world geography, like us states or countries in Africa. So I build https://popotopo.com (well I say "I" but you know..)
